overview_description.description: Founded and developed by salespeople, GetAccept helps sales reps accelerate the sales process from the first conversation to a sealed contract. It provides the best all-in-one sales platform where video, live chat, sales content, proposal design, document tracking, and e-signatures come together to simplify the life of every sales team. With GetAccept, sales reps forge relationships and build trust with the buyer in a remote and digital-first world.

about_short_description.short_description: GetAccept is an all-in-one sales enablement solution that assists B2B sales reps in closing remote deals.

product.name: Digital Sales Room
product.description: A platform that centralizes sales content, collaboration, and buyer engagement from opportunity to signed deal, integrated with CRM systems.

product.name: Proposals & Quotes
product.description: A tool to create, personalize, and send sales proposals and quotes using templates, with real-time tracking and CRM synchronization.

product.name: E-signatures
product.description: A secure, globally compliant electronic signature solution that facilitates faster contract signing from any device.

product.name: Contract Management
product.description: A system to store, manage, track, and organize contracts securely with visibility into document status and renewal reminders.

product.name: Sales Content Management
product.description: A content library that provides sales teams with easy access to relevant, on-brand sales materials for every stage of the buyer journey.

product.name: API and Automations
product.description: An API-driven platform enabling integration with CRM, ERP, and other systems to automate document generation, workflows, and data synchronization.
